description: Add a city to the end of a trip's ordered city list. This is idempotent when an equivalent city is already present. Pass city_name plus country: names are matched against the catalog (including aliases), a major city that shares its name with smaller places resolves to the major one, and a real town or island missing from the catalog (for example Bijagua or Santorini) is looked up in that country and added automatically.

city_id.description: Exact city catalog ID. Provide this OR city_name.

city_name.description: City, town or island name. Provide this OR city_id; ambiguous names return candidates, so pass country as well.

country.description: Country name or ISO code (for example CR or Costa Rica). Strongly recommended with city_name: it disambiguates same-named cities and lets Tineo add a place that is missing from the catalog.

name: trip_city_add
title: Add Trip City
